title: Smallest Value Of The Rearranged Number
description:
Rearrange the decimal digits of `num` to obtain the smallest possible value without changing its sign. A non-negative result cannot have leading zeroes; a negative result is minimized by placing its largest digit first. Return the resulting integer.

## Examples

```text
Input: num = 310
Output: 103
```

```text
Input: num = -7605
Output: -7650
```

## Constraints

- `-10^15 <= num <= 10^15`
